title: AuditEvent v1
description: Immutable audit trail event for compliance, governance, and forensic tracking. Every significant action in the EOIP platform generates an audit event: graph mutations, agent actions, tool invocations, access grants, and configuration changes.

audit_id.description: Unique, immutable identifier for this audit event. Never reused.

event_type.description: Category of the audited action (e.g. GRAPH_MUTATION, AGENT_ACTION, TOOL_INVOCATION, ACCESS_GRANT, CONFIG_CHANGE, AUTH_EVENT).

actor.description: Identity of the actor who performed the action (user ID, agent ID, or service account).

correlation_id.description: Request-scoped correlation ID linking related audit events across a single operation or workflow.

resource_refs.description: Canonical IDs or URIs of resources affected by this action.

outcome.description: Result of the action (e.g. SUCCESS, DENIED, ERROR, PARTIAL, ABSTAINED).

reason_code.description: Machine-readable reason code for denials or errors (e.g. INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGE, QUOTA_EXCEEDED, POLICY_VIOLATION).

safe_summary.description: Human-readable summary safe for display in audit logs. Must not contain PII, secrets, or sensitive payload data.
